title: cert chain: trust anchor signature never verified for self-signed root
description: In cert.rs validate_chain(), when signer_cert is itself in trust_anchors (self-signed root or single-cert chain), the loop finds the anchor by name match and calls verify_signature(current, anchor) where both args are the same cert — this is correct for a self-signed root. However if trust_anchors contains a root that signed the signer_cert directly, the code returns verify_signature(signer_cert, root_anchor) which is correct. Actual bug: check_validity() is called on current (the signer_cert) each iteration, but is NEVER called on the trust anchor itself before trusting it. An expired trust anchor is accepted.
